text: Scope: the 380 kV GIS interface and connection to the grid, generators (10MKA, 20MKA), generator circuit breakers and busducts, generator step-up transformers (10BAT, 20BAT), unit auxiliary transformers (10BBT, 20BBT), the 10.5 kV and 0.42 kV distribution, the emergency diesel generator, UPS and 220 V DC systems, cables and cable routes, earthing and lightning protection, lighting and small power, electrical protection and revenue metering. The generator and GSU internals supplied by the power island supplier (IEC) are covered only where they interface with the balance-of-plant electrical system.
